final: SELECT AVG(g.avg_fill) AS avg_of_group_avgs FROM (SELECT e.ordersmark, o.orderflow, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark WHERE e.expirespot BETWEEN '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY e.ordersmark, o.orderflow) g
